description: Find a venue in the Aurinia network. Venue types currently bookable: doctor, hostel. Optional: query (e.g. 'vertebrologist'), city, type. Returns a providers array; use a provider_id from it for get_availability / book.

city.description: City name, Latin or Cyrillic (e.g. Chernivtsi, Чернівці).

query.description: Free text: specialty, service or need, in English or Ukrainian (e.g. 'back pain', 'dorm bed', 'вертебролог'). May include the city.

name: find_providers
